source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Dedicated equipment for known infected clients in some cases, along with strict adherence to standard precautions and equipment disinfection protocols between clients","B":"Fairly few specific infection control measures actually being implemented beyond what standard hospital-wide precautions would already typically cover","C":"Declining to provide dialysis care altogether to any client who happens to have a known bloodborne infection diagnosed","D":"Measures considered relevant mainly during active outbreak situations specifically, rather than as part of routine, everyday dialysis unit operations"}}
source_row.rationale: Dialysis units implement specific infection control measures given the population's recognized increased risk for bloodborne pathogen transmission, which may include dedicated equipment for known infected clients in some circumstances, along with strict standard precautions and thorough equipment disinfection between all clients.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Dialysis Bloodborne Pathogen Prevention Guidelines
